cc:Work.dc:title: Different high-risk selections
cc:Work.dc:description: Public aggregate counts from Korobeinikova, Lvov and Pershin, Similar Scores, Different High-Risk Episodes. Readmission: 185 shared, 34 representation-specific episodes in each set of 219. ICU transfer: 153 shared, 51 representation-specific episodes in each set of 204. These are shares of each primary top-decile set, not classification errors or performance gains. Source: https://github.com/LvovDmitro/ehrshot-state-or-space/blob/4a8dfe18a048a3baa6fc21a8f727bc40d3ca4959/paper/aggregate_outputs/ensemble_top10_cross_representation.csv
